title: 翼型自噪声：记录工况组合留出基线
question: 固定五原输入Ridge对未参与训练的四非频率记录值组合预测scaled sound pressure时，保存局部误差如何支持下一步研究？
claim: The fixed five-input additive Ridge has lower pooled held-out setting-group MAE than the training-fold target-mean reference on all captured Airfoil Self-Noise records.
alternatives: The four-value exact setting tuples are operator-derived; they do not establish independent runs, original airfoil identities or validity outside the recorded wind tunnel conditions.
Suction-side displacement thickness is a recorded flow descriptor, not established here as an independently controlled or prospectively available design input.
Scaled sound-pressure dB errors describe the published response scale, not percentage error, acoustic energy, unscaled sound pressure or a general noise-reduction benefit.
Pooled MAE may hide adverse folds or setting groups; complete saved errors and genuinely supplied feedback must be distinguished from unread artifact references.
change_reason: Prospective full1503-row fixed protocol before data download, target inspection or estimator fitting. No transformation, tuning, outcome-dependent regrouping, historical case inclusion or runtime extension.
